warehouse-controller-brain-rehearsal.label: Warehouse Controller Brain Rehearsal
warehouse-controller-brain-rehearsal.summary: Virtual 16-encoder rehearsal that resolves controller pages into Rytm, Analog Four, Style Crates, queue, and recovery intent.

gestures.operator_goal: raise passive preview depth before choosing a direction
gestures.notes: Depth is staged only; no preview or send is executed.
Macro selection resolves to intent without mutating a snapshot.
Pad 5 keeps filter and LFO de-emphasized while SRC stays primary.
Pad 6 is eligible for useful tom source movement and light filter only.

gestures.operator_goal: prove Pad 12 remains optional but mapped
gestures.notes: Pad 12 stays in the product even when an operator leaves it quiet.

gestures.operator_goal: stage future Analog Four Track 1 macro movement
gestures.notes: Analog Four is still a passive runway in this rehearsal packet.
Crate browse remains a local intent selection.

gestures.operator_goal: stage the first upcoming queue move
gestures.notes: Queue staging does not dispatch Cockpit commands.

gestures.operator_goal: verify panic home always resolves to captured anchor intent
gestures.notes: Recovery target is passive until an approved armed bridge exists.

operator_notes: Treat the controller as an intent browser, not as a live MIDI input device.
Use SRC-first Rytm pad controls for Pads 5-12 before broad filter or LFO moves.
Keep Pad 12 available for users who want it, while allowing local lock/exclusion.
Analog Four controls are staged as runway intent until a validated A4 hardware path exists.
blocked_active_actions: MIDI learn or raw CC capture
